description: Part retrospective application for front boundary wall replacement with new front walls over 1m, pillars and gates
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall not be carried out otherwise than in complete accordance with the approved plans (as set out on page one of this decision notice).
For the avoidance of doubt and to ensure that the development is carried out as approved.

The planting/landscaping area as shown on drawing no. P02 Rev: B accompanying the application, shall be provided and all planting carried out by the end of the 2026/27 planting season. The planting/landscaping areas shall be retained thereafter.
In order to ensure a satisfactory external appearance
The railings and gates hereby approved shall remain of an open design and no screening or other barrier shall be added at any time.
In the interests visual amenity and highway safety.

Statement Required by Article 35 (2) of the Town and Country Planning (Development Management Procedure) (England) Order 2015: In accordance with paragraph 38 of the National Planning Policy Framework, improvements required to make the proposal acceptable were negotiated with Alan Lau by phone and e-mail. The revisions involved clarification on the planting/landscaping and the direction of the water dispersal. The amendments were subsequently submitted on 06/10/2026 & 07/10/2026.
